adr_0221_to_promote_disk.title: Agentic Development Pipeline Hardening
adr_0221_to_promote_disk.context: Session 2026-05-17 to 2026-05-18 surfaced 15 repeated/avoidable agentic-dev mistakes (enumerated below). Codify lessons + automate detection via fitness gates.
adr_0221_to_promote_disk.decision_summary: Adopt (1) pre-dispatch validation gates, (2) per-step verification CI gates, (3) doctrine intake automation, (4) PR-charter scope lock, (5) architecture map automation per session-start directive 2026-05-12.

fifteen_mistakes_codified.mistake: Spec version drift propagated from training data (claimed OpenAPI 3.3; actual 3.2.0)
5 persona-experience µservices dispatched with wrong abstraction (corrected to SaaS-product framing)
Plugin-app-store vs marketplace vs community taxonomy confusion
Foundry vs intelligence audience conflation (internal vs consumer)
Hiring + job-search-consumer dispatched as separate µservices (belonged in community)
fifteen_mistakes_codified.root_cause: no existing-catalog check before new µservice
no min-inputs guard on advisory gates

fifteen_mistakes_codified.mistake: Wave plan revised 5+ times before dispatch
fifteen_mistakes_codified.root_cause: wave plan unlocked during dispatch consideration

fifteen_mistakes_codified.mistake: Queued ADRs (0211/0212/0215-0220) lived only in conversation; almost lost
fifteen_mistakes_codified.root_cause: doctrine intake not auto-emitted to ADR scaffolds

fifteen_mistakes_codified.mistake: Wrong agent ID used for SendMessage (sent to aborted Persona-1)
fifteen_mistakes_codified.root_cause: no human-readable agent ID registry with status
fifteen_mistakes_codified.automation: agent ID registry primitive (future tooling PR; defer)

fifteen_mistakes_codified.mistake: 6 plugin-app-store IPs at 135-149 lines (under buildability bar)
fifteen_mistakes_codified.root_cause: buildability bar not enforced at agent-level

fifteen_mistakes_codified.mistake: 419 thin IPs left as ledger after 'expand 200' target
fifteen_mistakes_codified.root_cause: doc-coverage parallelized at wrong grain (1 agent for 32 packs vs 1 agent per pack)
fifteen_mistakes_codified.automation: dispatch-template recommends one-agent-per-µservice for doc-coverage waves
structural-rename helper via ast-grep; mandatory post-rename sweep verification

fifteen_mistakes_codified.mistake: ADR-0211 orphan citation in v3 audit (cited as Accepted; no file on disk)

fifteen_mistakes_codified.root_cause: no PR-charter locked at PR open

fifteen_mistakes_codified.mistake: Doctrine inflation per message (no-code, multi-context, ecosystem, intelligence, etc.)
fifteen_mistakes_codified.automation: doctrine-intake batching window; ADR draft + 24h review before adoption

four_new_ci_gates_to_author_follow_up_pr.purpose: Flag advisory gates with assertions_total == 0 (vacuous-pass detection)
four_new_ci_gates_to_author_follow_up_pr.mode: BLOCKER once 33+ µservices pass advisory checks
four_new_ci_gates_to_author_follow_up_pr.implementation_sketch: Walk registry/quality/lanes.yaml; for each gate, run; if exit 0 AND zero inputs validated → fail with 'gate is vacuously green'

four_new_ci_gates_to_author_follow_up_pr.purpose: Find ADR-NNNN references in any doc/spec/ADR but no docs/decisions/ADR-NNNN-*.md file
four_new_ci_gates_to_author_follow_up_pr.implementation_sketch: Walk docs/ + microservices/ + specs/ + evidence/; collect ADR-NNNN refs; cross-check docs/decisions/; fail on orphans

four_new_ci_gates_to_author_follow_up_pr.purpose: Every version pin in ADRs/PRDs/specs must cite WebSearch/Context7/upstream source URL
four_new_ci_gates_to_author_follow_up_pr.implementation_sketch: Walk ADRs/PRDs; find version pins (regex semver + lib name); cross-check for adjacent source URL citation

four_new_ci_gates_to_author_follow_up_pr.purpose: Structure-aware substantive-line count for IPs (excludes blank/heading/citation-only lines)
four_new_ci_gates_to_author_follow_up_pr.implementation_sketch: Parse markdown AST; count substantive content lines (not blank, not headings, not citation-only, not pure links); reject IPs with substantive < 150
